needed.suggestion: Create a continuous footway along the left side of the road to provide a safe pedestrian path.
Create a continuous footway along the right side of the road to provide a safe pedestrian path.
Install a signalised pedestrian crossing at this junction to allow safe crossing of the road.
Add a pedestrian refuge island in the middle of the signalised crossing to provide a safe place for pedestrians to wait.
Install dropped kerbs at the crossing to allow wheelchair users and those with mobility aids to access the footway.
Install street lighting along the road to improve visibility for pedestrians and drivers, especially at night.
